fallback: That didn't work — please try again.
network: Network request failed. Check your connection and retry.
HTTP_401: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
HTTP_403: You don't have permission to do that.
WORKSPACE_FORBIDDEN: You are not a member of this workspace.
WORKSPACE_ROLE_REQUIRED: Your workspace role cannot perform this action.
SESSION_READ_ONLY: This conversation belongs to another member and is read-only.
HTTP_404: We couldn't find what you asked for.
HTTP_409: That conflicted with another change. Refresh and retry.
HTTP_500: The server hit an error. Please try again shortly.
SANDBOX_NOT_READY: The sandbox isn't ready yet — create one first.
SESSION_BUSY: The session is still running — hold on.
HTTP_429: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
SESSION_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Conversations full ({{used}}/{{limit}}). Delete some old ones.
CONCURRENT_AGENT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Too many tasks running ({{used}}/{{limit}}). Please wait.
DESKTOP_NOT_READY: Your cloud desktop is not ready. Check setup progress; ordinary conversations can continue.
SANDBOX_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Ordinary LLM conversations can continue. Sandbox and cloud desktop access require an active paid plan.
runFailed: The reply failed. Please try again.
LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The model service is unavailable. Try again shortly, or pick another model.
AUTH_MOBILE_SESSION_REPLACED: Your account was signed in on another phone. Please sign in again.
AUTH_MOBILE_LOGIN_REQUIRED: Your session needs to be updated. Please sign in again on this phone.
PUSH_DEVICE_NOT_READY: Enable and connect notifications on this phone first.
PUSH_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server notification service is not enabled yet.
PUSH_TEST_RATE_LIMITED: Wait 30 seconds before sending another test notification.
PUSH_SETUP_FAILED: Notifications are not connected. Please retry.
